data.title: Machine Shop and Factory Hall
data.summary: Detailed machine tools, a modular steel factory hall, racking, handling gear and shop floor props in one stylised industrial family, built for machine shop and factory scenes.
data.description: Original CC0 machine shop library: engine and bench lathes, a turret mill, a pillar drill, surface and bench grinders, a horizontal bandsaw, a cut-off saw, a linisher, a guillotine, a press brake, a hydraulic press, an enclosed CNC machining centre, a welding bay, a powder coating oven, a compressor and a parts washer. Every machine is built as a real casting: rounded bodies with filleted edges, lathed chucks, shafts, lead screws and flywheels, spoked handwheels with ball handles, modelled knobs, levers, guards and doors, bolted feet, blank cast nameplates and a control station with a red emergency stop on a cream plate, in sage green enamel against bright brushed steel. Around them is a modular hall on a 6 m grid: columns, cladding, window and roller shutter bays, trusses, roof deck, a glazed ridge, a mezzanine with its stair, an overhead crane runway and bridge, and concrete floor tiles with safety yellow walkway lines. Racking, pallets, bar and sheet stock, tool cabinets, a forklift, a pallet truck, bins, drums and safety kit finish the floor. Named pivoted nodes carry rigid node-transform clips only: chucks and spindles turn, wheels and blades spin, carriages, tables, quills and rams travel, and doors, lids and drawers open and close. Belts, hoses, cables, chains and hydraulic lines are modelled solid and never move, and no linkage is faked. No manufacturer names, badges or artwork anywhere: every nameplate and label is blank.

starterScene.title: Day shift machine hall (Machine Shop and Factory Hall)
starterScene.summary: A working machine shop inside an 18 m steel hall: cladding, window and roller shutter bays on a 6 m grid with columns and trusses across, a decked bay and a glazed ridge over the back, a mezzanine and stair stocked with cartons, and an overhead crane on its runways. Two...
starterScene.description: A working machine shop inside an 18 m steel hall: cladding, window and roller shutter bays on a 6 m grid with columns and trusses across, a decked bay and a glazed ridge over the back, a mezzanine and stair stocked with cartons, and an overhead crane on its runways. Two lathes and the inspection plate stand front and centre, the mill, drill and surface grinder behind them, the bandsaw with the bar and sheet racks by the roller shutter, the presses and the enclosed machining centre down the right, two benches with their vices and tool walls, and the welding bay screened off in the far corner. Every machine has its tool cabinet, chip tray, coolant tank and swarf beside it; racking, pallets, stillages, a loaded forklift, drums, bins, extinguishers and bollards fill the rest of the floor. The front wall and the front roof bays are left off so the shop reads from above.

assets.description: A working machine shop inside an 18 m steel hall: cladding, window and roller shutter bays on a 6 m grid with columns and trusses across, a decked bay and a glazed ridge over the back, a mezzanine and stair stocked with cartons, and an overhead crane on its runways. Two lathes and the inspection plate stand front and centre, the mill, drill and surface grinder behind them, the bandsaw with the bar and sheet racks by the roller shutter, the presses and the enclosed machining centre down the right, two benches with their vices and tool walls, and the welding bay screened off in the far corner. Every machine has its tool cabinet, chip tray, coolant tank and swarf beside it; racking, pallets, stillages, a loaded forklift, drums, bins, extinguishers and bollards fill the rest of the floor. The front wall and the front roof bays are left off so the shop reads from above.
